description: Every published record in one set, collection or range, by name, each with its page on collectorists.com. The slug is the last part of the set page address, e.g. "beatrix-potter-50p" for a coin collection.

slug.description: The set's slug, e.g. "beatrix-potter-50p" or "urzas-saga"; search_catalogue names the set a record belongs to.

type.description: The kind of set, as search_catalogue reports a record's type: coin for a coin collection, card for a trading card set, toy for a LEGO® theme.

name: set_checklist
title: Set checklist
